text:
maria: Hey team :wave: Quick thread for the joint webinar next Thursday with CloudNova — main asks: live captions in EN/FR/DE, QR-based swag claim, and an automated demo handoff for remote speaker. Timeline below, need owners.

alex: I can own captions. Are we using a vendor or Zoom captions?

maria: Prefer vendor for better translation quality. CloudNova offered to cover French. We should cover German. Can you shortlist 2 vendors by EOD?

alex: Yup. I'll ping LiveTranscribe and CaptionFlow and get price + latency numbers.

devon: For QR swag flow — we planned stickers + insulated mug. Do we need to pre-print unique codes?

maria: Yes. Unique one-time QR per attendee to avoid duplicates. Also need customs-friendly packaging lists for EU.

jamie: I can coordinate the QR redemption page (small form -> shipping address). I'll make a Privacy blurb for EU compliance.

sasha: For demo handoff: remote partner speaker will be on stage + remote demo runner. We need deterministic failover: if stage video fails, remote runner should take presenter role and push demo to booth.

alex: Also captions integration: vendor must support SRT + live stream embedding. We will run a local captions relay to add vendor stream into our CDN.

maria: Good. Can we have a run-of-show snippet? Minimal: intro (5m), keynote (20m), live demo (25m), AMA (10m), wrap. Demo swap must be rehearsed.

jamie: draft run-of-show posted: https://redwood-internal.link/runofshow (private)

devon: I started a small CSV for swag manifest (code, item, qty, region). snippet:
```
code,item,qty,region
RN-QR-0001,sticker-pack,200,NA
RN-QR-0002,insulated-mug,50,EU
```

maria: Shipping-bot, can you confirm pickup ETA for EU mugs from vendor?

shipping-bot: ETA updated: EU pickup 2026-04-02. Tracking IDs will be posted in #logistics when booked.

alex: Vendor shortlist: LiveTranscribe (low latency, $250/event, supports FR), CaptionFlow (better translations, $420/event, demo scheduled). Recommend CaptionFlow for quality.

sasha: Rehearsal window: Tue 30m, Wed 30m. Remote partner needs NAT punch-through tested. Jamie, can we include a short check-in form?

jamie: Yup — will add preflight checklist: mic test, video + screen share, captions token, QR redemption test.

devon: For QR redemption, is there a per-region shipping cap? EU+UK has different UX for VAT. I'll add region column and a VAT flag.

maria: Decision: CaptionFlow approved, Jamies sets up redemption page + privacy, Devon finalizes manifest & customs notes, Alex integrates SRT relay. Sasha owns rehearsal schedule w/ partner.

alex: I'll set up a small docker relay. snippet of command:
```
docker run -p 8080:8080 caption-relay --source token --format srt
```

sasha: I'll schedule rehearsals and send calendar invites to CloudNova and our AV.

maria: Thanks all. One more thing — swag pickup onsite: ops-bot, can ops team hold 20 emergency mugs at venue?

ops-bot: Ops confirmed: 20 mugs hold, location: Green Room table B.

jamie: I'll also create a QR test link for the rehearsal: https://redwood-internal.link/qrtest (test creds: guest/test)

devon: I'll finalize manifest and upload to the shared drive by EOD today.

maria: Perfect. If any blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:
